question_text: Three large closed rooms X, Y and Z which are maintained at 40$^\circ C$, 35$^\circ C$ and 20$^\circ C$ respectively. Assume that all the rooms are saturated with water vapour. Consider the following statements:

options.option_text: If the person enters the room X, initially some of the sweat will begin to evaporate.
If the person enters the room Z, initially some of the sweat will begin to evaporate.
If the person enters the room Y, only true is true
only B and C are true
only A and B are true
